blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A heated altercation between two brothers turned fatal in Barangay Lahug, Cebu City, on Sunday night after one of them allegedly stabbed the other. The victim, identified as Francis, died while receiving treatment at a private hospital in Cebu City. In a report, police said the altercation between Francis, 43, and his younger brother, Jerry, 39, stemmed from a dispute over the use of Wi-Fi connection.
